name: Yelling
overview: Scripture reveals the profound impact of our words, showing that a harsh or wrathful tongue can wound deeply and provoke strife, while a gentle and wise speech brings healing and peace. The power of the tongue is so great that it can bring life or death, and controlling one's speech safeguards the soul from trouble. Patience and a soft answer are effective in calming anger and persuading even the most powerful, emphasizing the need for self-control and wisdom in how we communicate.
